tasks.label: Setup: create venv and install dependencies
args: cd "$(wslpath -u '${workspaceFolder}')" && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/ansible-galaxy collection install -r requirements.yml

tasks.label: Check: syntax of all playbooks
args: cd "$(wslpath -u '${workspaceFolder}')" && for playbook in precheck_only gi_patch rdbms_patch rollback; do .venv/bin/ansible-playbook playbooks/${playbook}.yml --syntax-check || exit $?; done

tasks.label: Run: read-only pre-checks
args: cd "$(wslpath -u '${workspaceFolder}')" && .venv/bin/ansible-playbook -i inventories/${input:env}/hosts.yml playbooks/precheck_only.yml -e env=${input:env} -e target_home=${input:targetHome} -e change_ref=${input:changeRef} -e mode=precheck_only

tasks.label: Run: patch workflow
args: echo 'Patch runs must be launched from AAP.'; exit 1
